description: A formula \(\varphi(\bar x)\) is preserved under extensions between models of \(T\) when every embedding \(f:M\hookrightarrow N\) between such models carries \(M\models\varphi[\bar a]\) to \(N\models\varphi[f(\bar a)]\).
